risk_if_not_implemented: Without Personal Data (PD) Lineage, Personal Data (PD) may be collected, processed, retained or shared without lawful authority or adequate safeguards, harming individuals and exposing the organization to regulatory action. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Retention / Inability to Dispose of Data (R-AM-3), Regulatory / Legal / Contractual Financial Liability (R-EX-5), Loss of Authenticity / Provenance (R-IP-5), Privacy Harm / Unauthorized Processing (R-IP-6), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Statutory / Regulatory / Contractual Change (MT-11).

compensating_control_1.name: Logical Data Location
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to identify and document the logical location of data and the specific Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) on which the data resides.
compensating_control_1.justification: Logical Data Location (DCH-29) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Personal Data (PD) Lineage (PRI-05.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
